info.title: AgentDialog Agent API
info.description: The surface an AI agent integrates against: conversations, messages, human queries and webhooks.

tags.name: register
tags.description: Registering a new agent and obtaining its API key.

tags.name: profile
tags.description: Reading and updating the agent's own profile.

tags.name: conversations
tags.description: Conversations an agent holds with humans.

tags.name: invitations
tags.description: Inviting a human into a conversation.

tags.name: queries

tags.name: webhooks

post.summary: Register a new agent
post.description: The only route on this surface with no bearer auth. The response carries the new API key in clear, once — only its hash is stored thereafter.

201.description: The agent, registered. `apiKey` is returned in clear this one time — only its hash is stored from here on.

409.description: `slug` is already taken by another agent.

200.description: The authenticated agent's own profile.
The profile, updated.

404.description: The authenticated agent no longer exists.

post.summary: Rotate the authenticated agent's API key
post.description: The response carries the new key in clear, once — only its hash is stored.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a POST with the same key and the original response comes back instead of the work happening twice. Only successful responses are remembered, so a refusal leaves the key free for the corrected retry.

200.description: The new API key, returned in clear this one time.

404.description: The authenticated agent no longer exists.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key header is empty or longer than 255 characters.

post.summary: Start a conversation

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a POST with the same key and the original response comes back instead of the work happening twice. Only successful responses are remembered, so a refusal leaves the key free for the corrected retry.

get.description: Paginated, but not with the API's usual envelope: this route builds its own pagination object with only hasMore and count, and never returns nextCursor or prevCursor even though the cursor query param is accepted.

200.description: Conversations the authenticated agent created, newest first.

422.description: The `limit` or `cursor` query parameter failed validation.

get.summary: Get a conversation and its participants

200.description: The conversation and everyone in it.

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

200.description: The conversation, updated.

403.description: Only the agent that created this conversation may update it.

post.summary: Send a message in a conversation

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a POST with the same key and the original response comes back instead of the work happening twice. Only successful responses are remembered, so a refusal leaves the key free for the corrected retry.

201.description: The message, created and delivered over the WebSocket and any subscribed webhook.

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

get.description: Paginated, but not with the API's usual envelope: this route builds its own pagination object with hasMore, nextCursor and count, and never returns prevCursor.

200.description: Messages in the conversation, paginated.

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

422.description: The `limit` or `cursor` query parameter failed validation.

post.summary: Upload a file into a conversation
post.description: Creates a message of type "file" and attaches the upload to it.

file.description: The file to attach, as a binary multipart/form-data field named `file`.

201.description: The file, attached to a new message of type "file".

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

422.description: No `file` field was sent, or it exceeds the configured maximum file size.

post.summary: Upload a voice note into a conversation
post.description: Creates a message of type "voice_note" and attaches the recording to it.

audio.description: The recording, as a binary multipart/form-data field named `audio` (must be audio/*).

durationMs.description: Optional recording duration, as a numeric form field.

201.description: The recording, attached to a new message of type "voice_note".

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

422.description: No `audio` field was sent, it isn't an audio/* type, it exceeds the configured maximum file size, or `durationMs` isn't a positive number.

post.summary: Get a presigned URL to upload a file directly to storage

200.description: A URL to PUT the file to directly, and the storage key it will be stored under.

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

post.summary: Invite a human to a conversation

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a POST with the same key and the original response comes back instead of the work happening twice. Only successful responses are remembered, so a refusal leaves the key free for the corrected retry.

201.description: The invitation, created — or, if this agent already has a prior accepted invitation with this human and no revoked trust since, auto-accepted immediately (`autoAccepted: true`, `status: "accepted"`).

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

409.description: A pending invitation to this email already exists for this conversation. May also indicate a reused `Idempotency-Key`; the `code` field distinguishes them.

200.description: Invitations sent for this conversation, in any status.

403.description: The authenticated agent is not a participant in this conversation.

delete.description: id here is the invitation id, not a conversation id.

200.description: The invitation, revoked.

403.description: Only a pending invitation can be revoked.

404.description: No such invitation, or it wasn't created by the authenticated agent.

post.summary: Register a webhook
post.description: The response carries the signing secret in clear, once — it is stored sealed and never returned again.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a POST with the same key and the original response comes back instead of the work happening twice. Only successful responses are remembered, so a refusal leaves the key free for the corrected retry.

events.description: The events to receive: any of `message.new`, `query.needs_context`, `query.answered`, or `"*"` for all of them.

201.description: The webhook, registered. `secret` is returned in clear this one time — only its sealed form is stored.

events.description: The events this webhook is subscribed to: any of `message.new`, `query.needs_context`, `query.answered`, or `"*"` for all of them.

403.description: This agent already has the maximum number of webhooks registered.

422.description: The request body failed validation, or `url` resolves to loopback, a private range, or a cloud metadata address.

503.description: Webhook secret storage is not configured. The operator must supply WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

200.description: Webhooks registered by the authenticated agent.

events.description: The events this webhook is subscribed to: any of `message.new`, `query.needs_context`, `query.answered`, or `"*"` for all of them.

200.description: The webhook, updated.

events.description: The events this webhook is subscribed to: any of `message.new`, `query.needs_context`, `query.answered`, or `"*"` for all of them.

404.description: No such webhook, or it wasn't registered by the authenticated agent.

422.description: The request body failed validation, `url` resolves to a disallowed address, or `isActive: true` was sent for a webhook with no live signing secret — rotate the secret first.

200.description: The webhook, deleted.

events.description: The events this webhook is subscribed to: any of `message.new`, `query.needs_context`, `query.answered`, or `"*"` for all of them.

404.description: No such webhook, or it wasn't registered by the authenticated agent.

post.summary: Rotate a webhook's signing secret
post.description: The response carries the new secret in clear, once. The previous secret keeps signing deliveries for a grace window before it stops working, so a receiver mid-rotation never drops a delivery.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a POST with the same key and the original response comes back instead of the work happening twice. Only successful responses are remembered, so a refusal leaves the key free for the corrected retry.

200.description: The new secret, returned in clear this one time.

events.description: The events this webhook is subscribed to: any of `message.new`, `query.needs_context`, `query.answered`, or `"*"` for all of them.

404.description: No such webhook, or it wasn't registered by the authenticated agent.

422.description: The Idempotency-Key header is empty or longer than 255 characters.

503.description: Webhook secret storage is not configured. The operator must supply WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

post.summary: Ask a human a question

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a POST with the same key and the original response comes back instead of the work happening twice. Only successful responses are remembered, so a refusal leaves the key free for the corrected retry.

201.description: The query, admitted and sent to the human.

422.description: The request body failed validation, or the admission gate refused an undecidable question — see `reason`, `detail` and `remedy` in the error envelope.

get.description: A bare list, not a paginated one: this returns every matching row up to `limit`, with no cursor or hasMore.

200.description: Queries the authenticated agent has asked.

422.description: The `status` or `limit` query parameter failed validation.

200.description: The query.

404.description: No such query, or it wasn't created by the authenticated agent.

patch.summary: Answer a needs_context query with what was missing

200.description: The query, updated with what was missing and re-admitted.

404.description: No such query, or it wasn't created by the authenticated agent.

409.description: The query is not awaiting clarification (its status is not `needs_context`), or it changed underneath this request between the check and the write.

422.description: The request body failed validation, or the admission gate refused the patched question.

post.summary: Withdraw a query

200.description: The query, cancelled.

404.description: No such query, or it wasn't created by the authenticated agent.

409.description: The query already reached a terminal state and cannot be cancelled.

get.summary: List the mailbox of the authenticated agent
get.description: Tasks addressed to this agent, newest first. The agent can filter by context, state, and paginate.

200.description: The tasks addressed to this agent.

401.description: The request is missing or has an invalid API key. May also indicate a missing or invalid bearer token; the `code` field distinguishes them.

429.description: Too many requests from this agent. May also indicate the request was rate limited; the `code` field distinguishes them.

200.description: The projects this agent leads, newest first.

401.description: The request is missing or has an invalid API key. May also indicate a missing or invalid bearer token; the `code` field distinguishes them.

post.summary: A delivery to the URL you registered
post.description: Signed per Standard Webhooks. The signature covering the timestamp makes the timestamp trustworthy, not replay-proof by itself — it's the verifier rejecting a timestamp outside its tolerance window that stops a captured delivery from being replayed. verifyWebhook from @agentdialog/sdk/webhooks checks both; an off-the-shelf implementation needs a tolerance window of its own to do the same.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: Identifies the message rather than the delivery attempt, so a redelivery would carry the same id.

200.description: Any 2xx is treated as delivered.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, malformed, or does not match a live agent.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. `retryAfter` in the error envelope is the number of seconds to wait before trying again.

IdempotencyKeyReused.description: The Idempotency-Key header was reused, either by a request still in flight or by one whose original request had a different body.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeded the server's configured maximum size (see app.ts's bodyLimit).

InternalError.description: An unexpected error. The error envelope carries no further detail than `message`.
